results.title: Few swing voters say a Trump endorsement would make them more likely to vote for a congressional candidate

results.content:
According to the latest RealClearPolling' generic Congressional voting polls, 48.7% said they'd vote Democrat, 42% said they'd vote Republican.

In the latest generic congressional voting poll by Economist/YouGov, 39% said if elections for Congress were being held today, they'd vote for the Democratic candidate compared to 32% that said Republican. A whopping 30% said other, not sure or that they would not vote at all.
results.title: How will Tuesday primary results impact November midterms 2026?

results.content:
Trump's slightly improving approval rating comes as the GOP continues to struggle against the Democrats in a generic congressional ballot. According to the newest poll, Democrats continue to hold an advantage of 6 percentage points over Republicans ahead of November’s midterm elections.

Tuesday’s The Economist/YouGov poll was conducted Aug. 21-24 among 1,536 U.S. adults. The poll's margin of error was plus or minus 3.5 percentage points.
